title: Global CRM & Lifecycle Marketing Manager
description:
Headquarters: Malta
URL: http://fpmarkets.com.au

Description

FP Markets Group of Companies is a well-established multi-regulated broker, founded in Australia, offering traders access to CFD trading on Forex, Indices, Commodities, Stocks and Cryptocurrencies. We are growing and looking to recruit a Full-time Global CRM & Lifecycle Marketing Manager (remote).

This role owns everything we say to a client between the moment they first raise their hand and the moment they place their first trade. You will design, build, send and continuously improve every automated and campaign communication across four funnel stages — Lead, Registration, First Time Deposit and First Time Trade — using email and WhatsApp, built and run in Salesforce Marketing Cloud. This is a hands-on build-and-send role rather than a strategy role: you will have the support of content, creative and analytics teams, but the journeys are yours to build, and each stage carries a conversion rate that is yours to move.

Reporting to: Chief Marketing Officer

Responsibilities:

Journey design & automation — Salesforce Marketing Cloud

  • Own the design, build and optimisation of automated journeys across all four funnel stages
  • Manage audience, segmentation, entry and suppression logic
  • Rationalise existing automations and maintain a documented, auditable journey estate

Email execution

  • Build, QA and deploy automated and campaign email communications
  • Own templates and modular content to enable scalable regional localisation
  • Manage deliverability, consent, preferences and list hygiene

WhatsApp execution

  • Own WhatsApp marketing end to end, from opt-in and template approval to sequencing and frequency management
  • Use data to determine channel allocation and optimise engagement
  • Manage channel costs, forecasting and provider relationships

Optimisation & measurement

  • Lead continuous testing across messaging, timing, channels, sequencing and offers
  • Partner with Analytics to measure performance through to funded account and first trade
  • Report on funnel conversion and explain key performance movements

Compliance

  • Embed jurisdictional and regulatory requirements into journey design
  • Partner with Compliance on efficient approvals and maintain a clear communications audit trail

Candidate profile:

  • Proven hands-on experience building multi-step nurture journeys and automated flows in Salesforce Marketing Cloud. You must be able to demonstrate what you have personally built; applications without clear hands-on SFMC experience cannot be progressed
  • Strong practical experience with Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Email Studio, Content Builder, Data Extensions and SQL for segmentation. AMPscript is an advantage; for Marketing Cloud Next, experience with Data Cloud, identity resolution and Flow is relevant
  • Demonstrable experience running WhatsApp as a marketing channel, including opt-ins, template approvals and the 24-hour service window. Email-only experience is not sufficient
  • Experience owning conversion performance, with clear examples of baseline results, changes made and measurable outcomes
  • Solid knowledge of email deliverability, consent and data-protection requirements across multiple jurisdictions
  • Comfortable writing automated-message copy and briefing creative where needed
  • Fluent English, written and spoken

Our offer:

  • Welcoming, young and multicultural team with approachable leadership
  • Ability to contribute to dynamic business at a growth phase
  • High level of autonomy, support of ideas and putting your expertise into the best practices for the company
  • Continuous personal development, training budget, growth with the company and opportunity to learn from industry leaders
  • Competitive remuneration, regular salary reviews and performance-based incentive schemes
  • Vibrant company life: from team activities to global celebrations

Journey to FP Markets:

  • Interview with HR (30 - 45 min)
  • Interview with your future manager (1h)

Join our team and be a part of a professional, rapidly-growing company operating in a multicultural environment!

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/fp-markets-global-crm-lifecycle-marketing-manager

title: Technical CRM Project Manager (French Speaking)
description:
Headquarters: Belgium
URL: http://hubledigital.com

Description

Welcome to Huble 👋, HubSpot’s 2024 global partner of the year! We are a global HubSpot, AI, marketing & creative consultancy enabling mid-market and enterprise businesses move faster, adapt smarter, and innovate freely—by building their business around HubSpot’s CRM. We believe in striking a balance between professionalism and being human.

As a Technical Project Manager, you will be the driving force behind the development and management of project plans for CRM integration projects within HubSpot. From start to finish, you will be involved in every aspect of the project, including discovery, implementation, UAT, change management, and integrations. Your expertise will be crucial in managing project scope, assessing requirements, and effectively communicating with stakeholders to ensure the successful delivery of projects.

🚀 Here are a few of the tasks you'll get to work on

1) Expertly managing project scheduling and budget planning

  • Develop a project plan that meets stakeholders/customers needs and delivers desired outcomes within budget.
  • Partner with Resource Managers to accurately predict and allocate the necessary resources.
  • Create and manage a budget that reflects the scope of work and resource requirements.

2) Streamlined project tracking, reporting, and administration

  • Responsible for completing, distributing, and storing all project documentation.
  • Ensuring timely preparation of briefs and resolving unclear or incomplete situations is your responsibility.
  • Monitor and provide regular updates to ensure project progress aligns with client goals.

3)Effective project communication, timeliness, and client satisfaction

  • Articulate problems and bring the right people together to solve them with a sense of urgency.
  • Monitoring communications and ensuring that all client communication is being responded to and dealt with.
  • Analyze project performance, identify areas for improvement, and effectively communicate and manage project risks.

🏗️ To excel in this role, you should have the following

  • A bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Information Science, or similar field.
  • Mid-level years of experience at a senior level working on systems integrations / CRM implementations projects.
  • Proficiency in Project Management Methodologies, preferably with formal training.
  • Experience in a Consultancy, Agency, or Software development organization is highly desirable.

⚡️ These personal qualities are key to your success

  • Have an unwavering passion for driving results and making things happen.
  • Approach problem-solving with a keen analytical mindset and meticulous attention to detail.
  • Thrive in fast-paced, ever-changing environments, successfully navigating complexity and embracing change.
  • Excel in forming strong interpersonal connections and possess remarkable resourcefulness.
  • Demonstrate exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proficient in English and French at a business level.

🎁 As part of the remuneration package, you will receive the following:

  • 🌍 Work from anywhere - Enjoy the freedom of remote work within the country of employment.
  • 👭 Quarterly social events - get to bond with your co-workers during our quarterly get-togethers.
  • 🪑 Create your ideal workspace - Receive a budget to set up your home office with your preferred desk and chair.
  • 💻 Choice of devices - Choose between a MacBook or Windows Laptop, complete with a monitor and mouse.
  • 🧘 Flexible working hours - Benefit from flexible working hours to accommodate your personal needs, whether it's for leisure or family commitments.
  • 👕 Show your company pride - Get your hands on Huble Swag.

🛣️ Interview Process

  • Intro Call (20 min)
  • 1st Interview (30 min)
  • Take-Home Assessment [2 days to complete]
  • 2nd Interview (45 min) - you will present your approach to the assessment
  • Final Interview (30 min)

🤝 Ready to make a move?

If you are ready to take on this exciting opportunity and join our team, we would love to hear from you. Apply today and let's Huble together!

NB - Please note that candidates must reside and have the legal right to work and current residency in the locations mentioned.

Please note that we have not enlisted the help of external recruiters for this role. If contacted by someone outside of Huble who does not have the @hubledigital.com email domain, please inform us immediately. Thank you!

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/huble-technical-crm-project-manager-french-speaking
